artifacts.notes: All 31 retained pages were visually inspected for ordering, legibility, completeness of the historical image area, polarity and absence of modern Google marks. Quanta occupies derivative pages 1–14, Syllabus 15–31. Native 600-dpi, 1-bit images are preserved; the 4,036,178-byte size was reviewed and retained to avoid lossy resampling. There is no searchable text layer and no full verbal collation claim.
